This document detail the items, which are checked on every (12) twelve years
 bases Y12 as recommended and defined in Mitsubishi catalogue maintenance as a
 Major maintenance P2.

This document is updated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar on 28 Aug 2004 and tested by eng. Nafad 
 Kamel Mahmoud revised by UEEPCO Quality control general director eng. Gamal 
 Abd El wahab and approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head Sector of El-Kureimat 
 power station.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category,

Safety fence 
 (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, i.e. safety shoes,
 helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.

Open the circuit breaker and open the DS's at both sides of the breaker 
 pole. Ground the main conductor.

Switch off the power supply to the control circuit and exhaust the 
 compressed air from the drain valve of the air reservoir.

Be sure to insert the closing or tripping preventative pins at the time of 
 internal inspection and inspection of moving parts.
Use designated lubricant.
Do not smear the lubricant on the insulators.

Renew all the O-rings at the flanges which have been opened for 
 inspection. Handle O-rings with special care to avoid any damage.
Do not disassemble the slide seal assemblies.
Tighten each bolt with a proper torque.
Test the leakage of all reassembled gas seals.

Compare the mechanical operation data obtained before and after the 
 inspection to insure orderly operation of the breaker.

Don't operate the circuit breaker by the pneumatic operating mechanism 
 when the Sf6 gas in the enclosures is below the lock pressure.
Complete set of maintenance hand tools.
220 V ac supply, Portable pressure gauge.
Emergency light, Timing equipment.
SF6 Gas leak detector.
Contact resistance tester model WRT-100

Introduction

 bases Y12 as recommended and defined in Mitsubishi catalogue maintenance as a
 Major maintenance P2.
This document is updated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar on 28 Aug 2004 and tested by eng. Nafad 
 Kamel Mahmoud revised by UEEPCO Quality control general director eng. Gamal 
 Abd El wahab and approved by eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head Sector of El-Kureimat 
 power station.
Safety Precautions
A work

 staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence

Appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, i.e. safety shoes,
 helmet, breathing mask, safety glasses.
Open the circuit breaker and open the DS's at both sides of the breaker

Switch off the power supply to the control circuit and exhaust the

Be sure to insert the closing or tripping preventative pins at the time of

Use designated lubricant.
Do not smear the lubricant on the insulators.
Renew all the O-rings at the flanges which have been opened for

Do not disassemble the slide seal assemblies.
Tighten each bolt with a proper torque.
Test the leakage of all reassembled gas seals.

 inspection to insure orderly operation of the breaker.
Don't operate the circuit breaker by the pneumatic operating mechanism
